scope: Illustrative command sequence, not an execution receipt. Replace guards using fresh inspection; outputs must be new paths.

workflow.purpose: Author and export one canonical recipe and native creature package.
workflow.guard: Recipe edits require observed revision and stateHash. The preview and package use the same compiler.

workflow.purpose: Refine portable visual geometry and materials while retaining gameplay in the original package.
workflow.guard: Use expected revision/state guards for existing project edits. Review material and geometry changes before exporting a visual definition.

workflow.purpose: Inspect and install the validated character package into a new portable project version.
workflow.guard: Replace HEX with the observed project fingerprint. On conflict inspect again; do not retry blindly. Use creature attach-visual when replacing only a refined visual.

boundaries: Cosmetic outfits grant no equipment bonuses.
Identity and personality do not silently alter authored appearance.
Presentation scenes and screenshots do not advance or validate gameplay.
Unmodified Studio exports recover their recipe. Advanced external visual changes require Scene Forge or engine authoring to preserve them.
